req.title: Player creation persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall commit newly created players to the players table so subsequent GET requests return them.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-019 requires that POST /players/ commits a new player to the DB and that a subsequent GET returns it. The suite covers: (1) EP positive — valid new player returns 201 and is retrievable via GET; (2) NEG negative — duplicate squad_number returns 409 and body is not re-persisted; (3) BVA boundary — squad_number at the edge of the pre-loaded range (27, one above the highest seeded value 26) to catch off-by-one mutations; (4) DT decision-table — missing required field returns 422 (Pydantic validation path, not DB path); (5) STC state-transition — POST then GET by squad_number confirms the state transition from 'not-exists' to 'persisted'. All tests use exact status codes, exact field values, and verify both the write and the subsequent read to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_post_player_persists_and_get_returns_it
preconditions: DB is pre-loaded with 26 rows (squad numbers 1-26)
Squad number 99 does not exist in the DB
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
Assert response body contains all submitted fields plus a UUID id
Assert GET response status is exactly 200
Assert GET response body matches the created player
expected: Response JSON contains firstName='Testfirst', lastName='Testlast', squadNumber=99, position='Goalkeeper'
Response JSON contains a non-null 'id' field
GET response body matches the POST response body
trace: R-PLAYER-019: newly created player must be committed to DB
R-PLAYER-019: subsequent GET must return the created player
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_persists_and_get_returns_it():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Testfirst",
        "lastName": "Testlast",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Testfirst"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Testlast"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body
    uuid.UUID(body["id"])  # must be a valid UUID
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/99")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["id"] == body["id"]
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Testfirst"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Testlast"
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert get_body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"

tests.name: test_post_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409
preconditions: DB is pre-loaded with squad number 10 (Kabir Mary Reddy)
actions: Assert response detail contains conflict message
GET /players/squadnumber/10 to confirm original record unchanged
expected: Response detail is 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
GET /players/squadnumber/10 still returns the original player (Kabir Reddy)
trace: R-PLAYER-019: duplicate squad_number must not overwrite existing record
player_route.py: HTTP 409 Conflict raised when existing player found
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_duplicate_squad_number_returns_409():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Duplicate",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 10,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 409
    detail = post_r.json().get("detail", "")
    assert detail == "A Player with this squad number already exists."
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/10")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Kabir"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Reddy"
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 10

tests.name: test_post_player_state_transition_not_exists_to_persisted
actions: Assert all fields match the submitted payload exactly
expected: POST returns HTTP 201 with Location header '/players/squadnumber/50'
Final GET body has firstName='Priya', lastName='Chopra2', squadNumber=50, position='Left-Back', starting11=true
trace: R-PLAYER-019: state transition from non-existent to persisted
STC: covers the full lifecycle: absent -> created -> retrievable
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_state_transition_not_exists_to_persisted():
    pre_get = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert pre_get.status_code == 404
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Priya",
        "lastName": "Chopra2",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Left-Back",
        "starting11": True
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert body["firstName"] == "Priya"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Chopra2"
    assert body["position"] == "Left-Back"
    assert body["starting11"] is True
    location = post_r.headers.get("location", "")
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/50"
    post_get = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert post_get.status_code == 200
    gb = post_get.json()
    assert gb["firstName"] == "Priya"
    assert gb["lastName"] == "Chopra2"
    assert gb["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert gb["position"] == "Left-Back"
    assert gb["starting11"] is True

tests.name: test_post_player_optional_fields_null_persists_correctly
actions: POST /players/ with only required fields (no optional fields)
Assert optional fields are null/None in response
GET /players/squadnumber/97 and assert optional fields are null
expected: middleName, dateOfBirth, abbrPosition, team, league, starting11 are null in response
GET returns HTTP 200 with same null optional fields
trace: R-PLAYER-019: minimal valid payload must persist and be retrievable
EP: partition of requests with only required fields
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_optional_fields_null_persists_correctly():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Minimal",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 97,
        "position": "Right Winger"
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Minimal"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 97
    assert body["position"] == "Right Winger"
    assert body["middleName"] is None
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] is None
    assert body["abbrPosition"] is None
    assert body["team"] is None
    assert body["league"] is None
    assert body["starting11"] is None
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/97")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    gb = get_r.json()
    assert gb["squadNumber"] == 97
    assert gb["middleName"] is None
    assert gb["starting11"] is None
